title: monoverse.json
description: A package's Monoverse settings, beside its package.json. `monoverse lint` and DevTools check a package with this file; a package without it is not checked.

sourceRoots.description: The folders the rules check, relative to the package. "." is the whole package. No absolute path, and no "..".

ignore.description: Globs, relative to the package, of files the rules skip: tests, fixtures. A folder covers everything inside it.

preset.description: Ready-made rules. default: code is shared only through shared/ folders. kabuki: a Kabuki app's doors and contracts.

rules.description: The package's own rules, instead of a preset. A rule left out is off.

imports.description: A file imports its own module, the index file of any module below it, or, beside or above it, a door's index file.

doors.description: Door folders, as paths from the folder that owns them. A * matches one folder name: services/*/contract.

contracts.description: A contract folder exports only Context.Service and error classes as values, and the required ones exist.

folders.description: Contract folders, as paths from the folder that owns them: services/*/contract.

required.description: Of those, the ones that must exist.

exceptions.description: Imports the imports rule lets through. An exception that lets nothing through is an error.

from.description: A glob, relative to the package, of the importing files. A folder covers everything inside it.

to.description: A glob, relative to the package, of the files imported.

restrictions.description: Imports refused on top of the rules; no exception lifts one. A restriction whose "from" covers no checked file is an error.

from.description: A glob, relative to the package, of the importing files. A folder covers everything inside it.

to.description: What they may not import: a glob of files, relative to the package, or a package name, which covers its subpaths: "react", "@effect/*".
